about_the_game:
The second volume of the  Slaughter Horse 2 soundtrack, featuring 21 new tracks - over an hour of music.

The tracks are provided as .wav files and 320kbps MP3 files. Although I retain copyright on all tracks, please feel free to use them in any videos or other creative projects you might be up to. I would appreciate credit if you do so, and don't forget to let me know if you use them in anything!

content_descriptors.notes: Slaughter Horse 2 contains text descriptions of violence, murder and mayhem against cartoon animals. There is no overt gore or otherwise depicted. There are text only references to murder, suicide and sexual activity, and animated depictions of ponies being hanged.
